tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page, slide and canvas ground. Dark matches the live site (#1C1C1C); light is Bone White. Every text color below names the grounds it reads on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, table fills and cards sitting on surface. Dark value is Graphite. Never set bronze text on the dark value (2.87:1, fails).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and the logo's ground logic. On surface 15.1:1 in both themes; on surface-raised 10.1:1 (dark) and 17.0:1 (light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table labels. On surface 9.9:1 (dark) and 10.1:1 (light); on surface-raised 6.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers on surface only. Not a control border: it is under 3:1, so inputs and buttons use ink-muted for their outline.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Signature accent: rules, key numbers, large headlines (24px+ or bold 19px+), icons, CTA underlines. On dark surface 4.28:1 and on light surface 3.53:1, so large text and UI only, never body copy. Never on surface-raised in the dark theme (2.87:1). Never a flood behind body copy. This is a brand color, not the Matte Bronze finish.

tokens.name: on-bronze
tokens.usage: Text on a bronze fill. 4.85:1.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: High-visibility accent for the one thing that must be seen: primary buttons, sale or new flags, a callout number. Text and lines on dark surface 10.3:1 and on surface-raised 6.9:1. On light surface it is 1.5:1: use it only as a fill carrying on-highlight text, never as text or a line. Never beside bronze in one component.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight fill. 11.6:1.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Restricted to safety, torque and do-not markers, as a rule or bar beside the warning. Never set text in signal on dark (2.3:1). On light surface 6.6:1 is fine for a bar or label.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill. 6.6:1. Warning copy on dark grounds is set in ink, with signal as the bar beside it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid. Reads at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: jackman-black
tokens.usage: Print black and the ground for logo artwork on press. Use surface for screens. Text on it: bone 17.1:1.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Bone White as a fixed value (reversed type, light panels) regardless of theme.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Fixed Graphite for panel fills. Bone on it 10.1:1; silver on it 6.6:1; khaki on it 5.0:1. Never bronze on it.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Machined Silver: spec-table header fills, technical diagram lines. Ink text on it is 9.9:1; never bone or bronze on it.

tokens.name: khaki
tokens.usage: Desert Khaki: heritage and apparel support, story-led pieces. Text on dark surface 7.4:1. Never bone, bronze or silver on it; graphite text on it 5.0:1.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero statements and model names. Set ALL CAPS in Poppins Bold with 0.18em tracking, as the site does. Print: 48pt on 48pt.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and document titles, ALL CAPS. Print: 30pt on 34pt.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings, ALL CAPS. Print: 20pt on 24pt.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, table titles, ALL CAPS. Print: 14pt on 18pt.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Harry Jackman flame-cut spokes by hand and welded them to 3/8-inch outer rims.
styles.usage: All running copy, sentence case. 16px is the digital minimum. Print: 10pt on 15pt, never under 9pt.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis and lead-ins. Use instead of italics or underlines.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Classic 68 | Matte Bronze, front three-quarter view
styles.usage: Image captions and table footnotes. Print: 8pt on 11pt.

styles.name: legal
styles.sample: Radial Flow Form is a trademark of Official Wheel Company.
styles.usage: Disclaimers and trademark notices. Print: 6.5pt on 9pt, never under 6pt.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Labels above headings, table column headers, ALL CAPS.

styles.name: part-number
styles.usage: Part numbers, SKUs, fitment strings and torque values. Monospace stops 8/B and 0/O misreads that cause wrong-fitment orders.

spacing.note: Built on the guide's 3pt baseline (4px) and 12pt gutter (16px). Print margin is 0.5in (48px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One baseline step. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label over value, caption under image.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, small button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Column gutter (12pt), card padding, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margin (0.5in). Logo-safe inset from trim is 0.25in (24px).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major sections, slide margins.

radius.note: Proposed, not in the source guide: the brand reads industrial, so corners stay nearly square. Confirm with the Marketing Specialist.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, panels, document blocks, the default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Image frames and cards on web.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Badge-shaped avatars only.
